## 镜头 6：减速弯 T8（左）（5 秒）

- 弯道：T8 左 约 90°，减速弯后半
- 海拔：41 m → 40 m
- 速度：约 95 → 120 km/h，全圈最慢的一段

**运行前** 先把挑好的关键帧放进 `input/`：首帧 `dream8_K5.png`，尾帧 `dream7_K5.png`。文件不存在时 LoadImage 会报 *value not in list*。

点一次 **运行** 生成 2 条候选，视频保存在 `output/video/dream8/`，文件名形如 `shot_06_t1_00001_.mp4`。

挑出最好的一条，复制为拼接脚本读取的文件：

```
mkdir -p output/video/dream8/selected
cp output/video/dream8/shot_06_t1_00001_.mp4 output/video/dream8/selected/shot_06.mp4
```

At low speed, just out of a right-hand corner, the car turns sharply LEFT through a tight corner of almost ninety degrees, bouncing over the tall red-and-white kerb on the inside left, the view rotating to the left and the scenery swinging to the right across the frame. The exit of this left-hander is right on the crest of the hill: as the car turns, the long downhill straight swings into view from the left, and as the driver unwinds the steering the road ahead becomes one dead-straight line dropping steeply down the hillside, with the valley opening up below. After the left turn there are no more corners and no right-hand bend; the car simply accelerates straight down the hill, the view tilting smoothly downwards as it goes over the crest. Single continuous take from the same onboard camera, no cuts, no camera switch, the car always moves forward and never reverses, no on-screen text, no watermark. Visual style: Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.
